summary: This is an at-the-market (ATM) shelf takedown prospectus supplement amendment filed by Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd under Rule 424(b)(5). The company may sell up to $9.3M in ADSs (each representing 300 ordinary shares) through Leerink Partners as sales agent with a 3% commission. There are no minimum sale requirements, no escrow, and the offering is an ordinary capital-raising mechanism under an existing S-3 shelf registration. The filing does not describe a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign; it is a routine equity distribution update.
